name: @seniorinsight/contracts
description: Contratos compartilhados do SeniorInsight: especificações OpenAPI dos serviços e JSON Schemas dos eventos (CloudEvents) publicados no RabbitMQ (exchange `si.events`).

scripts.generate: openapi-typescript openapi/care-v1.yaml -o generated/ts/care-v1.ts && openapi-typescript openapi/identity-v1.yaml -o generated/ts/identity-v1.ts && openapi-typescript openapi/notification-v1.yaml -o generated/ts/notification-v1.ts
scripts.validate: npm run lint:openapi && npm run validate:events && npm run typecheck
